# hostwarden_port_group (Resource)

A virtual machine port group on a standard virtual switch of a host.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_id` (String)
- `name` (String) Port group name: the network name virtual machines connect to.
- `vswitch` (String) Standard virtual switch, e.g. vSwitch0.

### Optional

- `vlan` (Number) VLAN id: 0 none, 1-4094 tagged, 4095 trunk (default 0).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <host_id>/<name>.
